entities.name: Query acidic PLA2
observations: 139 aa precursor with residues 1–16 matching a secretory signal peptide; mature chain is residues 17–139.
Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt A8E2V8, acidic phospholipase A2 Tgc-E6 from Trimeresurus gracilis.
Contains Pfam Phospholip_A2_1 domain at residues 18–122.
Curated annotation assigns EC 3.1.1.4, secreted monomeric snake-venom phospholipase A2.
Reference active-site positions are 63 and 105; one Ca2+ ion is bound.

entities.name: A8E2V8 Tgc-E6
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Trimeresurus gracilis; exact sequence match to the query.
Annotated as a snake venom phospholipase A2 that hydrolyzes the 2-acyl group of 3-sn-phosphoglycerides.
Annotated calcium cofactor requirement: binds one Ca2+ ion.

entities.name: PLA2 2-acyl hydrolysis
observations: Rhea RHEA:15801: a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine + H2O = a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine + a fatty acid + H+.
The enzyme cleaves the ester bond at the sn-2 position of glycerophospholipids; Ca2+ supports catalysis and substrate binding.

entities.name: Query PLA2 properties
observations: Sequence-derived molecular weight is approximately 15.69 kDa, theoretical pI 4.73, and charge at pH 7 approximately −6.53.
Seven disulfide bonds are annotated in the exact reference, consistent with a compact secreted venom PLA2 fold.
